title: Obsolescence detection — Resource Retirement Manager (Signature)

demo:
# Resource Retirement Manager demo: obsolescence scoring -> proposal -> tombstone.
import time
NOW=time.time(); DAY=86400
RES=[{"id":"ds-v1","last_read":NOW-400*DAY,"superseded_by":"ds-v2","hold":False},
     {"id":"ds-v2","last_read":NOW-2*DAY,"superseded_by":None,"hold":False},
     {"id":"legal-dump","last_read":NOW-900*DAY,"superseded_by":None,"hold":True}]

    if stale or r["superseded_by"]:
        print(r["id"],"-> PROPOSE retirement; successor:",r["superseded_by"],"tombstone will persist")
